name: The leaking spire
description: The renegade symbol: an upside down Consulate symbol with flourishes emptying out of the bottom, representing hope that aether is returned to the people.

description_citations.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.
